'''Kerd K'Kerren''' was a famous [[Podracer/Legends|podracer]] who had every inch of his hands, face and neck covered in intricate [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] of green and gold. The left side of his head was shaved and tattooed with swirls and checks.
